subject: executor, expression: detach projection and selection operator (#54864)
summary: Adds Detach support for ProjectionExec and SelectionExec by converting SessionEvalContext to StaticEvalContext when no optional eval props are required; exports optional-prop detection (GetOptionalEvalPropsForExpr) and exposes required-props on EvaluatorSuite; avoids copying sync.WaitGroup by switching ProjectionExec.wg to a pointer.
